note: Lens output verbatim (records removed). firstOccupancyInCircleAndWindow is adjudicator-only truth, never shown to the model.

coverage.coverage_statement: Mapped from 97.97% of granted records in the pinned register; 233 unresolved rows are withheld from the map and reported here.

ceiling.grantIsNotBuilt: Granted administrative licences. A granted licence means an administrative grant was recorded; it is not evidence that work started, construction occurred or completed, occupancy happened, or the permitted quantity was built.
ceiling.noApprovalRate: Granted-only universe: no application or refusal denominator, so no approval, rejection or success rate exists.
ceiling.noCrossFamilyTotal: Building/urbanistic, activity and temporary-activity licences are three different families and are never summed into one total.

lens.ceiling: A count of granted administrative urban licences spatially included in the Lens circle (scope ADDRESS_POINT), by family and grant-date window. GRANTED-ONLY: the register is RESOLUCION=Conceder, so there is no applications/refusals denominator and NO approval rate, rejection rate, refusal count or success rate exists. A granted licence is NOT evidence that work started, construction occurred or completed, occupancy happened, or the permitted quantity was built: granted is not built. The three families (building/urbanistic, activity, temporary activity) are NOT one homogeneous universe and are NEVER summed into a single cross-family total. The mapped layer is the RESOLVED SUBSET of the register; unresolved rows are reported in the coverage metadata and never dropped from the denominator. The crosswalk may resolve via current or historical official callejero, with distinct current/historical administrative-geography provenance. Licence records may concern places also present in Censo de Locales, licensed VUT or hospitality/activity evidence; these universes are NEVER summed as unique businesses or sites. Counts are ADDRESS_POINT records and are never converted into a barrio-level figure, ranked by barrio or district, or rendered as a density, heatmap or choropleth surface. Responsible declarations (dataset 133556) are not ingested.
